formalization: Lean certified: for universe-0 categorical premodels, closure under actual infinitary term denotations, unrestricted original-closed-type Infinitary Comprehension and ☐ND at type t imply faithful full-standard representation. The representation retains the original closed root-domain carriers, quotients observationally equivalent reachable worlds, preserves infinitary truth through grounding, and represents every proposition profile and every external function at an admitted relational-output type. Separate full-standard validity reports give the converse semantic direction. Supporting certificates cover regular-cardinal parameter-bound strictness, the countable finite-C reduct, the finite syntax bridge, cardinal closure, and the two infinitary action countermodels. Nominal Atomicity is semantic profile-order Atomicity; general action Atomicity and Rigid Comprehension retain their root-level premises. The result is neither recursive proof-calculus completeness nor equivalence with finitary Choice Classicism; arbitrary-universe forward representation and the full H-theta application are not certified.

supporting_results: Full standard soundness concerns the explicit lambda-free infinitary syntax, arbitrary parameter assignments and allowed full relational functions. It does not establish effective finite axiomatizability.

Nominal strictness uses universe 0, regular infinite kappa and fewer than kappa distinct typed parameter symbols actually occurring in each matrix. Arbitrary unused ambient parameters and arbitrary universe-small Boolean branching remain allowed.

Nominal Atomicity means explicit semantic profile-order Atomicity. C5 and Intensionality use actual syntax. This is not a native Meta.Model transport certificate or a quoted native P.Atomicity theorem.

The countable strictness construction includes an actual finite C reduct, infinite individuals, faithful profiles and modal collapse, but its profile Atomicity and its infinitary comprehension failure retain the defined Henkin language scope.

CardinalClosure gives externally coded short-operation closure in an elementary first-order substructure under explicit regularity, cardinal arithmetic, language size and ambient-size assumptions. It does not implement H-theta, formula coding, satisfaction absoluteness or the typed Henkin reduct needed for the full H-theta argument.
General action Atomicity/RC endpoints are at the root and retain their source closure/comprehension/modelhood premises. No automatic boxed upgrade is certified.
The finite bridge embeds the actual finite lambda-free syntax and preserves substitution/evaluation; it is not a proof-calculus soundness theorem for arbitrary C5 Premodels.
Observer helpers are C-side object-derivation certificates for their exact stated premises. They do not certify the separate general finite-list or lambda-free observer bootstrap.
Countermodels retain actual expanded full action semantics: surjection comprehension plus necessary Barcan at each original closed type fails ND_t; idempotent comprehension fails BF_t and ND_t.
